items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] since. Do you remember when they had that crevasse about two years before Depression? That was down around Poitras and Vala. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yes.

ctx.x: Dubin. A little place they called back there. Dubin. Dubin, yeah. But I lived back there a while. I was sick and came over here. I've been over here ever since. I come from Bellashad. Bellashad, that's my home. I came from Bellashad when I was a little years old. You were going there and there. Yeah, going to Bellashad. And then I came in that high water, that first, first crevasse. Mm-hmm. And then I came in that high water, that first crevasse. Mm-hmm. And then I came in that high water, that first crevasse.…
